items.question: Do you know who's planning Jane’s going-away party?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Do you know who's planning Jane’s going-away party?”，自然应答是“think it's Tom Shields.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（think it's Tom Shields.）。
